The '''Cragh Mountains''' were a ragged, rocky range of peaks located on the planet [[Sorl]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Noor R'aya]] built a small home in the Cragh Mountains after leaving the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].
